Author: Acharya A, Pokharel B, Pandit SB, Bartaula S
Comment: Table 2's column headers appear mis-ordered in the extracted text ('No' then 'Yes'). The narrative disambiguates: "Nasal spray ... was able to resolve OME in exactly two-thirds of the cases" (Group B = 27/40 improved, so 13/40 persistent) and "In placebo [observation] group, there was improvement in less than one-fifth of the cases" (Group D = 7/40 improved, so 33/40 persistent). Persistence counts therefore derived as total minus improved. The X2=26.6, df=3, p<0.001 is the OMNIBUS test across all four groups, not the B-vs-D pairwise test; p_value=0.001 recorded as the reported upper bound for the significant pairwise Tukey comparisons.
